1) distributed information retrieval enables knowledge discovery from Web-scale documents; 2) semiotic and inductive methods enable inferring associations between concepts from these documents; and 3) these concept associations form the basis of a human-oriented, fuzzy semantic net that enables interactive knowledge browsing and searching.

1) distributed computing infrastructure can be used for Web-scale knowledge discovery, 2) semiotic and inductive methods are useful for knowledge retrieval, and 3) human-oriented, associative interfaces can be used for browsing and searching the Web.
